verifier_audit_fixes.issue_found_in_calibration: Fixture accession numbers and shipment IDs embedded the same random tag as the participant's email and MRN, so a reasonable case-insensitive email-token redactor also clipped the withdrawn participant's accession number (1 of 3 fresh runs, zero PHI leaked).
verifier_audit_fixes.fix: Accession numbers and shipment IDs now use an independent random token, so only genuine PHI handling is scored.

difficulty_takeaway: On v3, frontier agents average 97.4% partial credit but only 1 of 6 runs fully pass (reward 1.0). The remaining failures are concentrated in two narrow obligations, replay suppression and initials redaction, that agents reproduce consistently across both runs, which points to genuine blind spots rather than noise. Partial credit stays high because the embedded 5-store stack fits in one context window; a multi-service variant (Postgres, OpenSearch, MinIO, Redpanda) is the honest route to lower partial scores.
